notes: Desktop/shelf unit; not natively rack-mountable (official guide: "fits...in any electronics rack using a third-party shelf... 3 units across a standard rack, 1U of vertical space") so rackUnits omitted. Power: external auto-switching AC-DC adapter (100-240V AC in, output 12.0VDC/1.0A/12.0W) feeding a DC barrel-style input on the unit — modeled as dc-barrel; no grade applies (power, not signal). "Digital audio out" is an S/PDIF coaxial output physically using an RCA-style plug (no dedicated S/PDIF-coax id in the allowed connector list), so it is represented with connector "rca" alongside the analog RCA in/out — do not confuse the three RCA-type jacks. "Analog audio in" and "Analog audio out" are each a stereo pair (L/R) sharing one RCA jack pair per direction; modeled as one input port and one output port. 12V trigger is a control output using a 3.5mm mono/stereo mini-jack (manual: "Use a stereo or 3.5 mm to 3.5 mm cable"), mapped to trs-3.5 with no grade (control voltage, not audio). Two Ethernet ports are both 10/100 Mbps (eth-100m) switch/bridge ports for daisy-chaining, not WAN/LAN distinct roles. No USB port exists on this device. Source: official Sonos Port User Guide PDF (rear "Connector panel" diagram + full Specifications table), cross-checked against Sonos official Fact Sheet PDF and Sonos support pages — all agree on port set (2x Ethernet, RCA in, RCA out, digital coax out, 12V trigger, AC power via included external supply).
